focus: Trace repository hook trust, Git hook installation and persistent gates, and runtime preflight advisory delivery
keyQuestions: How do worktree naming/provisioning, Commit-Id allocation, hook trust, global hooks, and preflight advice interact?
answeredQuestions: How do worktree naming/provisioning, Commit-Id allocation, hook trust, global hooks, and preflight advice interact?
noveltyJustification: Trust, hook installation, persistent gate ownership, and runtime advisory delivery complete the hook interaction map.

label: Repository hook code runs only for the install checkout/worktrees or after local skilled.trustRepoHooks=true; command and environment config do not grant trust, and trust covers every branch of that repository.

Installer --status reports the effective core.hooksPath scope, target directory, hook source and resolution, shadowing, and effective message contract; setup can inspect this without installing hooks.

Persistent optional gate settings are speckit.hooks.<key> in local or global config, while per-push approvals, commit-message rules, whole-hook switches, and core.hooksPath have different owners or are explicitly outside /doctor:git hooks mutation scope.

The preflight advisory reads hard-rules.json through six runtime adapters but is warning-only and fail-open; setup can prove rule and adapter wiring plus configured suppression, but not enforcement or live delivery.
